text: {"reasoning":"To independently check the claim, I query EU refunds by month across June-July 2026 and break them out by refund reason, which is the most likely driver of a month-over-month change. I include Commerce.refundAmount (the magnitude), Commerce.refundRate (to see whether refunds grew faster than volume), and Commerce.orderCount as the record-count measure so each cell carries the sample size behind it. Filtering on Commerce.region = EU and slicing Commerce.orderedAt by month over the two-month range lets me recompute the increase from the ground up rather than reusing the analyst's construction.","query":{"measures":["Commerce.refundAmount","Commerce.refundRate","Commerce.orderCount","Commerce.grossRevenue"],"dimensions":["Commerce.refundReason"],"time_dimensions":[{"dimension":"Commerce.orderedAt","granularity":"month","date_range":["2026-06-01","2026-07-31"]}],"filters":[{"member":"Commerce.region","operator":"equals","values":["EU"]}]}}
